backend/main.mo: Main canister code defining user profiles, races, teams, holidays, and in‑memory maps plus comparison utilities and constants.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new structure by adding teams, holidays, and counters.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files and components with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of frontend file paths with brief descriptions of each file’s purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining color variables and base theme styles including dark mode.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React router configuration wiring all application pages including admin and system routes.
frontend/src/assets/generatedAssets.ts: Exports paths to generated image asset packs such as logos, cars, trails, and banners.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccessDeni: Reusable component showing an access denied message with a link back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAudit: Displays a scrollable list of audit entries with action badges, user info, and timestamps using local state.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Blocks access to children unless the user is logged in and verified as an admin, showing loading and denial screens as needed.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Shows a dialog prompting new authenticated users to create a profile and submits data via a saveProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with navigation, authentication handling, and conditional admin/user menus.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackVisual: Renders a race track visualization showing player and optional ghost opponent progress as moving car icons.
frontend/src/components/race/WordZoneInd: Displays the user's typing zone and target word count in either compact or card layout formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a Dfinity actor tied to the current identity, refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides queries to check if the caller is an admin or retrieve the caller's user role via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useEconomy.ts: Provides mutations for granting TRP coins as an admin and completing races, invalidating related user profile queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useGhostOpponents.ts: Generates ghost opponents from leaderboard data and animates their race progress over time.
frontend/src/hooks/useHolidays.ts: Defines queries and mutations for fetching, adding, and removing holidays through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInventory.ts: Fetches the current user's inventory using their authenticated principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeaderboards.ts: Retrieves leaderboard entries and augments them with basic user profile placeholders.
frontend/src/hooks/useMotd.ts: Returns a static MOTD placeholder with no backend integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for actor-based backend calls, including profiles, inventory, leaderboards, admin actions, and race performance.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeams.ts: Provides hooks to fetch teams, fetch a team by ID, and create new teams via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/adminCommandParser.ts: Parses admin command strings into structured actions such as creating titles, setting MOTD, adding text, or granting coins.
frontend/src/lib/raceMetrics.ts: Calculates typing race metrics including WPM, accuracy, and elapsed time.
frontend/src/lib/raceTextGeneration.ts: Generates race text based on effective WPM, including word-pool selection and zone-based length targeting.
frontend/src/lib/wordZones.ts: Maps WPM ranges to word count zones and selects appropriate target word counts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the app by configuring React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBannersPag: Admin placeholder page for managing banner designs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarsPage.t: Admin placeholder page for managing car inventory.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarTemplat: Admin placeholder page for managing car templates.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCustomizeI: Provides a grid of admin links for managing cars, templates, banners, trails, nitros, and titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminEconomyToo: Implements a form allowing admins to grant TRP Coins to users with validation and API calls.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminHomePage.t: Acts as the admin dashboard with links to text management, customization, economy, MOTD, admin control, and the update assistant.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminManagement: Allows admins to grant or revoke admin privileges via Principal ID validation and mutation calls.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMotdPage.t: Placeholder page for configuring the Message of the Day.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminNitrosPage: Placeholder interface for managing nitro effects.
Placeholder page for managing race texts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTitlesPage: Placeholder page for managing player titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTrailsPage: Placeholder page for managing trail effects.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUpdateAssi: Provides a natural-language command parser and executor for admin actions such as granting TRP Coins.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TextDemoPage.ts: Placeholder interface for testing race texts.
frontend/src/pages/CustomizePage.tsx: Renders a customization interface with tabs for cars, banners, trails, and titles, each showing placeholder content when none are owned.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays a welcome dashboard with race, leaderboard, and team links for unauthenticated users and a personalized summary for logged-in users.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardsPage.tsx: Shows leaderboards for speed, accuracy, and combined score with dynamic icons, loading states, and ranked entries.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the logged-in user's profile, join date, and performance stats with loading and login-required states.
frontend/src/pages/RaceHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a user's recent race results with timestamps, stats, and loading or empty states.
frontend/src/pages/RaceLobbyPage.tsx: Provides a lobby to start solo, ghost, or practice races, showing estimated word zone info and requiring login.
frontend/src/pages/RacePage.tsx: Typing race page that generates race text, tracks progress and metrics, handles ghosts, and saves race results.
frontend/src/pages/RaceResultsPage.tsx: Displays race summary including WPM, accuracy, rewards, and save status after a race.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Placeholder shop page showing no purchasable items yet.
frontend/src/pages/SystemPage.tsx: System settings page for seasonal themes and managing holidays with admin controls.
frontend/src/pages/TeamDetailsPage.tsx: Shows detailed info about a specific team, including members, balance, and membership status.
frontend/src/pages/TeamsPage.tsx: Lists teams and provides a dialog to create a new team if the user has enough coins.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL and hash parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current state, including TRP coin features, team requirements, and a seasonal System tab roadmap.
